this machine is already in the team Acme on https://control.example, and a machine is in one team at a time. To work with the team Beta and keep this machine where it is, share a session with that team (Share session…, in the session menu). To move it there, use Team … beside it in Devices and machines… (the account menu). `arugulad leave`, then join again, also moves it, but takes it off control until it's approved again.
